extDescription.message: Puts downloaded STL, STEP, 3MF and ZIP files into per-site folders: MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse and others.

optRoot.message: Main folder inside the downloads folder

optRootHint.message: The browser only allows paths inside its downloads folder. Example: 3D Models

optZipHint.message: ZIP files are moved only when they come from a site in the list above.

optPerModel.message: Put each model in its own subfolder

optPerModelHint.message: The name comes from the model page title, otherwise from the file name. PlatePilot shows such a subfolder as one source.

optConflict.message: If another extension also renames downloads (onDeterminingFilename), the browser applies only one of them — turn the other one off.
